metadata.title: Swarmhouse — warehouse control room
metadata.description: Platform for managing robots in a simulated warehouse

hero.title: Build a warehouse and watch robots deliver the goods
hero.lead: Draw a map, place stations and robots, and create delivery tasks. The simulation runs on the server, and the whole team sees changes in real time.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: Four steps from an empty map to the first delivery.

buildMap.title: Build the map
buildMap.description: Place walls, aisles, loading stations and delivery points.

addRobots.title: Add robots
addRobots.description: Set up the warehouse fleet and assign the robots their starting positions.

createTasks.title: Create tasks
createTasks.description: Specify the cargo, the pickup station and the route's destination.

observe.title: Watch
observe.description: Follow robot movement, the task queue and the warehouse state.

features.title: Features
features.subtitle: Everything you need to run the simulation and work together.

realtime.title: Real-time control room
realtime.description: The map, robots and tasks update for the whole team at once.

idleReasons.title: Clear idle reasons
idleReasons.description: See right away why a robot stopped, is waiting for a route or cannot continue.

collaboration.title: Collaboration
collaboration.description: The owner manages the warehouse while observers follow the simulation.

aiAssistant.title: AI assistant
aiAssistant.description: Helps prepare tasks and quickly understand the state of the warehouse.

telegram.title: Telegram notifications
telegram.description: Reports a finished task, an error or a robot that has been stuck for a long time.

serverSide.title: Keeps running after you close the tab
serverSide.description: The simulation runs on the server and does not depend on an open browser.

cta.title: Your first warehouse in minutes
cta.description: Add a station, one robot and your first delivery task.
cta.action: Sign in to create a warehouse
